item.title: Asking Strangers in Tokyo How to Say “I Love You”
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks people in Japan how to say “I love you” in Japanese. The conversation explores romantic expressions, language differences, and how people communicate their feelings in Japanese culture.

item.title: Dating Confessions and Awkward Encounters on Tokyo's Streets
item.description: Tokyo Sims heads out into the rainy streets of Japan for another round of unpredictable interviews. From dating advice and unusual flirting techniques to relationship confessions and bizarre encounters, the conversations quickly take unexpected turns.
